name: Causal Organism Product Physical
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; The drug directly physically engages the organism-produced molecule The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.; The disease-causing organism produces the drug-targeted molecular product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces.; The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.
hypothesis: Engagement of a molecule produced by a causal organism may interrupt infection through a molecular target.

nodes.role: Organism asserted to cause the disease
nodes.explanation: Organism asserted to cause the disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.
edges.exclusion_rationale: This arm tests the exact stated relation; response, adverse, treatment, and other more-specific assertions would change its biological meaning.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug directly physically engages the organism-produced molecule The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The disease-causing organism produces the drug-targeted molecular product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.

mechanism.rationale: Engagement of a molecule produced by a causal organism may interrupt infection through a molecular target. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[organism_product:{{relationship_types:organism_product}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE organism_product.predicate IN {{predicates:organism_product}} MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:{{relationship_types:infection}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN {{predicates:infection}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
An organism-produced molecule is not necessarily a virulence factor; host response and generic products may confound the path.
